purpose: Bounded release-regression benchmark for the real conversation work-run and event-stream path on the supported hosted Apple Silicon profile.
claim_boundary: This is a release-regression ceiling for the deterministic local mock provider, not a universal latency or remote-model claim.
The benchmark exercises the same work-run and event-stream path used by the app.
Results are valid only for the exact source SHA, runner/runtime manifestation and workload recorded in the receipt.
Threshold changes after first execution require a versioned benchmark revision and justification.
